sources.entry: RelaGit - The elegant solution to graphical version control. Built by developers, for developers. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/relagit/relagit) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: RelaGit
summary.one_liner: RelaGit is a graphical Git client for developers that integrates with GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg.
keywords: git ui alternative to command line
use_cases: manage git repositories with a graphical interface
work with GitHub, GitLab, or Codeberg repos from one client
automate actions on repository events like commits
customise the look of a git client with themes
view focused repo information in a separate popout window
summary.what_it_does: RelaGit is a modern graphical version control client aimed at developers, offering the features expected from a git client. It integrates directly with GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg. It supports workflows written as TypeScript files in a .relagit/workflows folder that run hooks such as commit events. It includes a native popout view for focused information about current work and allows the interface to be restyled through built-in theme creation or community themes.
notable: Automation workflows written in TypeScript with repository hooks such as commit
Direct integration with GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg
caveats: Pricing not stated on the page; the awesome-mac listing marks it as open source and freeware
